meta.title: margin-line-detection · LRO Front, Worker, Python Compute
meta.subtitle: MLE · system rst · margin line computation for a given tooth

views.label: Submit and poll
views.note: Callers pass an oriented model triangulation plus tooth information and receive an Operation.

views.label: Claim and compute
views.note: The worker claims one row, keeps the lease alive, then calls the Python sidecar over localhost:50071.

views.label: Inside the worker pod
views.note: No retry loop here. A readiness check keeps the pod out of service until the sidecar answers.

cards.title: The only rst family MLE owns
items: Every other MLE service sits under dia, moa, tmo or pen
The front takes an oriented model triangulation plus tooth information
The Deployment is contributed by k8s/postgres-lro-patch/lro, not by this directory

cards.title: Readiness instead of retries
items: There is no computeRetries loop; the worker calls Compute exactly once per item
ComputeReadinessCheck probes the sidecar so the pod stays unready until it answers
GetProductVersion is also pulled from the sidecar and recorded with the result

cards.title: Resource shape
items: The sidecar requests only 100m and 2Gi but may burst to 5 CPU and 10Gi
That is the lightest steady-state footprint of any MLE compute image
The Go container stays at 1 CPU and 1024Mi, as in every other family

cards.title: Operations
items: LRO threshold is 45s under RST-001, temporarily raised and tracked in MLE-2198
The margin-line-detection-job key under RST-002 has no directory in this repo
